_comment: Pool 2 — Pune digital agencies, 30-70 staff. Sourced 2026-08-11 from published agency directories (soravjain.com, builtinpune.in) and audited with stack_detect.py. Deliberately excludes Merkle, Techmagnate, SRV Media, Amura and Magneto: all 120-16,000 staff, which is the wrong motion for a $14.99/seat product.
_why_this_pool: An agency at this size is the highest-LTV prospect wrrk has. It needs the product twice over: internally for 30-70 staff (attendance, leave, payroll, tasks, timesheets) and commercially for client work (proposals, contracts, invoices, one inbox per client). It is also the only pool that can resell, which is exactly who GoHighLevel takes and wrrk's own battlecard at new/src/app/vs/data.ts targets back.
_local_advantage: All Pune. Wachas is Pune-based, so 'I am ten minutes away, happy to come by' is available here and is worth more than any cold-email line.
